caption: The drawing depicts two views of an intricately designed porcelain basket, rendered primarily in shades of blue and white. The top view shows a round plate with a pierced, open lattice rim composed of repeating oval shapes and decorated around the edge with a subtle blue pattern. The center of the plate displays a blue floral motif featuring a large central rose surrounded by smaller flowers and leaves, as well as a small bird. The side view below reveals the basket's shallow, flared form with openwork sides also made up of interlocking oval loops. Blue-painted flowers are applied at the intersections of the loops along the rim and sides, adding decoration and dimension. The composition places the top view directly above the side view, both set against a plain, light-colored background. The artist's signature, "FRANCES LICHTEN," appears at the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Fruit Basket
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
